say:2:1321003001:1.text: Tell me, how hard is it to manage the art supplies? It's such a simple job, yet you still keep messing it up!
say:2:1321003001:1.source_cn: 管理画具如此简单的一件小事，为什么你还能出这么多差错？

say:3:1321003002:1.text: It is our duty to pay attention to His Lordship's preferences and habits at all times! For example, he always reaches for brushes on his right while painting, so why did you put the brush stand on the left?
say:3:1321003002:1.source_cn: 想服侍好子爵先生，必须时刻注意他的喜好与习惯！先生作画...

say:4:1321003003:1.text: As His Lordship's longest-serving attendant, I handle far more tasks than you, and they're much more complicated. Yet, I've never made such careless mistakes. You could really learn a thing or two from me!
say:4:1321003003:1.source_cn: 作为陪伴子爵先生最久的仆人，我每天要做的事比你更多更繁...

say:5:1321003004:1.text: But didn't you also buy tea His Lordship hates last time? We had to serve it to Miss Valka and those guests just to get rid of it...
say:5:1321003004:1.source_cn: 可是，您上次也买到了子爵先生讨厌的茶叶。为了消耗它们，...

say:8:1321003005:1.text: Wait a second... Those guests weren't us, were they?
say:8:1321003005:1.source_cn: 等一下！你们说的那些贵客不会就是我们吧？！

say:9:1321003006:1.text: *Gasp* Oh my, since when did you arrive? Excuse me for the poor hospitality! Please don't let what he said bother you!
say:9:1321003006:1.source_cn: 客……客人！您怎么突然来了，是我招待不周……哎呀，请别...

say:12:1321003007:1.text:
But I'm just telling the truth...
You always sneak off to slack whenever His Lordship steps out... I've seen it with my own eyes.
say:12:1321003007:1.source_cn: ……我说的都是真的。\n子爵先生外出取材时，您也常常躲...

say:13:1321003008:1.text: W-who said I was slacking?! I-I was working on perfecting my tea-brewing technique!
say:13:1321003008:1.source_cn: 谁……谁告诉你我是去偷懒了？！我明明是在钻研如何泡一壶好茶！

say:14:1321003009:1.text: Hmph, even if my work is occasionally less than flawless, at least I don't lose or damage His Lordship's art supplies like you. Do you have any idea how important the right tools are to an artist?
say:14:1321003009:1.source_cn: 咳，即使我的工作偶尔做得不够尽善尽美，却也不会像你那样...

say:15:1321003010:1.text: And don't get me started on the countless times you've failed to clean the brush holder or restock white paint on time.
say:15:1321003010:1.source_cn: 至于没有定期清洗笔筒、及时补上白色的颜料之类的小纰漏，...

say:16:1321003011:1.text: I—I haven't made such mistakes recently!
say:16:1321003011:1.source_cn: 我、我最近没犯过这种错！

say:17:1321003012:1.text: Do I need to remind you about His Lordship's favorite tea set you broke last month?
say:17:1321003012:1.source_cn: 而且，你上个月也打碎了子爵先生最珍爱的那套茶具啊……

say:18:1321003013:1.text: I-I was trying to... Argh! Forget it!

say:19:1321003014:1.text: In any case, a careless attendant like you is hardly fit to serve His Lordship properly. From now on, it's better if I handle all the important tasks.
say:19:1321003014:1.source_cn: 总之，像你这么粗心的侍从，是很难服侍好子爵先生的。以后...

say:20:1321003015:1.text: That's not fair! I didn't do anything wrong...!
say:20:1321003015:1.source_cn: 不……不行，我又没做错什么……！

choice_prompt:21:1321003015.text: That's not fair! I didn't do anything wrong...!
choice_prompt:21:1321003015.source_cn: 不……不行，我又没做错什么……！

say:22:1321003016:1.text: Oh no, esteemed guest, this is not a trivial matter.
say:22:1321003016:1.source_cn: 不不不，尊敬的客人，这可不是一件小事。
say:22:1321003016:1.male: Oh no, esteemed guest, this is not a trivial matter.
say:22:1321003016:1.female: Oh no, esteemed guest, this is not a trivial matter.

say:23:1321003018:1.text: Allow me to present an idea, though I hesitate to impose.
say:23:1321003018:1.source_cn: 这样吧。为了不打扰子爵先生的休息，在下有个不情之请。
say:23:1321003018:1.male: Allow me to present an idea, though I hesitate to impose.
say:23:1321003018:1.female: Allow me to present an idea, though I hesitate to impose.

say:24:1321003019:1.text: Would you care to <style="highlight">experience our duties</style> and decide for yourself who is more useful and capable?
say:24:1321003019:1.male: Would you care to <style="highlight">experience our duties</style> and decide for yourself who is more useful and capable?
say:24:1321003019:1.female: Would you care to <style="highlight">experience our duties</style> and decide for yourself who is more useful and capable?

say:25:1321003020:1.text: What do you say, Mister Flower?

say:28:1321003022:1.text: As His Lordship's attendant, isn't it all about being useful?
say:28:1321003022:1.source_cn: 作为侍从，最重要的不就是有用吗……？
say:28:1321003022:1.male: As His Lordship's attendant, isn't it all about being useful?
say:28:1321003022:1.female: As His Lordship's attendant, isn't it all about being useful?

say:32:1321003025:1.text: Anyway, please experience my work first. This way, please.
say:32:1321003025:1.source_cn: 不论如何，请您先体验一下我的工作吧。这边请。
say:32:1321003025:1.male: Anyway, please experience my work first. This way, please.
say:32:1321003025:1.female: Anyway, please experience my work first. This way, please.

choice:27:0:1.text: Must usefulness be the only standard?
choice:27:0:1.source_cn: 一定要以有用没用作为标准吗？
choice:27:0:1.male: Must usefulness be the only standard?
choice:27:0:1.female: Must usefulness be the only standard?

say:34:1321003023:1.text: *Chuckle* If I were a useless teapot, I'd have broken into pieces long ago.
say:34:1321003023:1.source_cn: 您说笑了。如果我是一盏没用的茶壶，那么早该碎成碎片了。
say:34:1321003023:1.male: *Chuckle* If I were a useless teapot, I'd have broken into pieces long ago.
say:34:1321003023:1.female: *Chuckle* If I were a useless teapot, I'd have broken into pieces long ago.

choice:27:1:2.source_cn: 也许创造你们不是因为“有用”？

choice:21:0:1.text: Don't fight over something so trivial!
choice:21:0:1.male: Don't fight over something so trivial!
choice:21:0:1.female: Don't fight over something so trivial!

say:35:1321003017:1.text: Oh no, then we must stop arguing immediately. Apologies for my earlier behavior.
say:35:1321003017:1.source_cn: 噢，那可不行。客人，请您原谅我的失礼。
say:35:1321003017:1.male: Oh no, then we must stop arguing immediately. Apologies for my earlier behavior.
say:35:1321003017:1.female: Oh no, then we must stop arguing immediately. Apologies for my earlier behavior.

choice:21:1:2.source_cn: 再吵下去，柳博米尔就要听到了
